g.text: Merchant as Merchant App or POS
QRIS as QRIS Network or Acquirer
Issuer as Customer Bank or Wallet
Create QRIS payment request (order_id, amount, expiry, metadata)
Run monitoring checks and alert if needed
Show pending or failed based on UX policy
Return state (QR_ISSUED or PAID or FAILED or EXPIRED or REVIEW)
Record adjustment with audit log reference
